reviews.text: With so many scam chimney sweep businesses popping up , I’m so thankful to have found Ken and his company. He came out to clean our fireplace and he was such a pleasure to work with.
reviews.author: Casey A.

reviews.text: I cannot express how wonderful Ken is at the work he does! He's so honest and personable. He taught us so much about our woodburner set up. He did a fabulous job on our chimney and made safety suggestions so that we can continue enjoying our woodburner.
reviews.author: Steve E.

reviews.text: Cannot say enough about this Company. We had a smoke issue and Ken (second generation owner) squeezed us in making it an even longer than normal day for him.He was incredibly professional and spend time with us answering questions.
reviews.author: Donna W.
